_comment: MinHash + LSH overlap for corpus-v1 (TSAI, 23 Nov 2026: exact all-pairs overlap is not run at corpus scale). Same inputs, splits, floor and pack inventory as overlap.json; 128 hashes in 32 bands of 4 (agreement test, dedup v2 item 11: every qualifying H1/H2 pair of the exact method found). Paths are relative to the repository root. workers 16: one worker peaked at 0.8-0.9 GB on the largest sample parts (per-part signatures) and 1.5 GB while re-reading candidates, so 16 workers stay under about 24 GB on the 64 GiB job host; 0 (all cores) could use about 48 GB on 32 vCPU.
